I'm now refining the main body text in `Home.tsx` to communicate a concise value proposition. The focus is on operational excellence as the key driver of profit. I want to convey that this excellence is not an option but a competitive advantage. I'm also highlighting how we transform processes into financial assets, emphasizing our commitment to maximizing the bottom line.


**Updating the Home Component**

I'm now revising the call-to-action (CTA) area and its styling within `Home.tsx`. I'm integrating a new CTA that says "TESTER VOTRE POTENTIEL DE GAIN". I'm also including a note about the exclusivity of the firm's services. The file uses `Section` components and Tailwind classes, so I'll be adjusting the layout to ensure the "elite/minimalist" aesthetic is preserved with the longer text.


**Implementing Headline Refinements**

I'm now revising the main headline of the home page within the first `section`. I need to swap out the existing content of the `relative z-10` container.
